steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each alarm and trip is placed in the order it happened on the shift.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Trip with no cause recorded
findings.fix: Record the cause of the trip

findings.title: Alarm acknowledged but not cleared for over an hour
findings.fix: Check the alarm and clear it

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] alarm-trip-c.md:12  Trip with no cause recorded.
       Fix: Record the cause of the trip.
[medium] alarm-ack-e.md:19  Alarm acknowledged but not cleared for over an hour.
       Fix: Check the alarm and clear it.
[low] alarm-pump-a.md:26  Alarm with no action.
       Fix: Record the action taken.
Not checked: Alarms not in the log.
pros: Checks an alarm with no action, an alarm acknowledged but not cleared for more than an hour, and a trip with no cause recorded.
cons: Not checked: Alarms not in the log.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-shift-alarm-log skill on the records for this review.
